keyEvents.text: Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! West Ham United 0, West Bromwich Albion 1. Felix Myhre (West Bromwich Albion) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jimmy-Jay Morgan.
Delay in match (West Bromwich Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! West Ham United 1, West Bromwich Albion 1. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham United) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mohamadou Kanté.
Second Half begins West Ham United 1, West Bromwich Albion 1.
Goal! West Ham United 1, West Bromwich Albion 2. Jimmy-Jay Morgan (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Felix Myhre.
Substitution, West Ham United. Joël Piroe replaces Pablo.
Substitution, West Ham United. Manor Solomon replaces Divine Mukasa.
Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, West Ham United. Tomás Soucek replaces Mohamadou Kanté.
Substitution, West Ham United. Joël Veltman replaces Kyle Walker-Peters because of an injury.
Substitution, West Ham United. Valentín Castellanos replaces Airidas Golambeckis.
Goal! West Ham United 1, West Bromwich Albion 3. Callum Styles (West Bromwich Albion) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Jimmy-Jay Morgan (West Bromwich Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Kareem Tunde replaces Rabby Nzingoula.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Aune Heggebø replaces Jimmy-Jay Morgan because of an injury.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Tammer Bany replaces Felix Myhre.
Arne Engels (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Max O'Leary (West Bromwich Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jayson Molumby (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, West Ham United 1, West Bromwich Albion 3.
